subject: Mobile Development
title: Apple Silicon in Phones
description: A micro-lesson that makes Apple Silicon in Phones usable.

hook.text: In 2010, Apple stopped using off-the-shelf chips and designed its own: the A4.

buildup.text: Custom silicon let Apple optimize hardware and software together for maximum efficiency.

discovery.text: Each year, Apple's new chip leapfrogged competitors. The A-series became the gold standard.

twist.text: Qualcomm and Samsung struggled to match performance per watt, despite huge R&D budgets.

climax.text: Apple's chip advantage eventually expanded to laptops, desktops, and headsets.

punchline.text: Apple's best product might be its chips.

quiz.question: What was Apple's first custom mobile chip?
